# Launch

Project Alpha launch date is the fourteenth of March. The launch codename is BLUE HERON.

# Budget

Alpha budget owners must file expense reports within ten working days. The Q1 budget cap is 420000.

# Invoice

Purchase order ZX-4419 must appear on every line item. The amount due is 18750.50 and is payable by 12 April. Shipping is FOB origin.

# Field research

The Beta team studies migratory patterns of arctic terns. Field work happens in Svalbard every June.

# Termination

Employment may be terminated with 30 days written notice. Garden leave applies to directors.

# Security

Production SSH keys rotate every 90 days. The vault path is secret/folio/prod.

# Vendors

Preferred carrier is Northwind Logistics. The P1 incident SLA is four hours.

# Offices

Headquarters is in Austin. The satellite office is in Lisbon.

# On-call

Primary on-call is Priya Chen. Secondary is Jonah Hale.

# Holidays

The office is closed on 4 July and 25 December.

# Retention

Chat logs are retained for 18 months. Document bytes are retained until the user deletes them.
